description: This PHP class 'TimesheetColumn' is part of the OrangeHRM Time module, representing a data transfer object (DTO) for timesheet columns. It encapsulates a date and a total count, providing methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: TimesheetColumn
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a timesheet column with a date and a total count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TimesheetColumn with a specific date.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with this timesheet column.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total count for this timesheet column.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total count by a specified amount and returns the new total.
